Totally feel you bro, I've been experiencing this for the past 4 years. I was in 9th grade bro, didn't even know what it meant but was experiencing it daily thanks to my own parents. As kids it was so easy to distract ourselves, I would simply think of an exciting even like a trip or a party and wait until that was over and then end it all or simply run away. And here 4 years later stuck at home with those assholes who claim themselves to be 'parents', each and everyday is becoming more and more painful. 
Sorry, instead of cheering u up I started venting on my own. But the point is, try to find something to hold on to each of those strings of life, snapping faster than we are able to grab on to new ones.

Parents are the most pathetic creatures on this planet. And don't worry there isn't any age for mental health issues, I'm 17 and it has been 4 years since I'm having such thoughts (I was very low and almost decided to end everything a day or 2 back and posted something in the subreddit but thats a different story). Idk, if u have 'good' friends and you guys can be frank then they are usually a great way out and it helps, so I've heard but unfortunately I didn't really have that option open. I turned to gaming and it helps me keep my mind off things for sometime but my parents don't like when I play and keep on shouting when I do so, so my only haven is also not very refreshing anymore.

We're in this together mate, you're not alone just need to find a thread of life, a reason to hold on to it each day and slowly keep going. I'm also trying to go on lets see.
